purpose: Define registrar and early-career GP pathways: training support, supervision conversations, session progression, readiness, and provider-number guidance.
boundaries: Registrar intake is capacity-based — never marketed as always-open
Readiness tools inform conversations; they never auto-approve placement
Medicare provider numbers are issued by Services Australia — WMC does not issue, approve, or guarantee them
College training authorities remain external; WMC provides practice placement support only

tracks.label: Registrar
tracks.who: Enrolled in college GP training (e.g. AGPT / ACRRM pathway)
tracks.criticalDependency: Named supervisor capacity, training term fit, college rules
tracks.intakePosture: Placement only when supervision + rooms + nursing align

tracks.label: Early-career GP
tracks.who: Recently fellowed or early years of independent consulting
tracks.criticalDependency: Readiness, list-building support, staged sessions, peer access
tracks.intakePosture: Continuity philosophy with lighter formal supervision than registrar terms

journey.label: 0 · Discover
journey.doctorJob: Find WMC as a continuity practice; read pathway honesty
journey.question: Is supervision / early-career support real here?

journey.label: 1 · Orient
journey.doctorJob: Understand training support, sessions, PN boundaries
journey.question: What can WMC assist vs what external bodies decide?

journey.label: 2 · Self-check
journey.question: Am I document-ready enough for a serious conversation?

journey.label: 3 · Express interest
journey.doctorJob: Direct practice EOI — not a job board
journey.question: How do I start a practice conversation?

journey.label: 4 · Mutual assess
journey.doctorJob: Fit, credentials, capacity; registrar includes supervisor gate
journey.question: Is there capacity this term / these sessions?

journey.label: 5 · Provider-number prep
journey.question: Who issues my number? What does WMC supply?

journey.label: 6 · Session plan
journey.doctorJob: Agree starting footprint; registrar may be term-shaped
journey.question: What days are reliable for patients and training?

journey.label: 7 · Supervise / support
journey.doctorJob: Scheduled supervision or peer access plus ad-hoc clinical help
journey.question: Who do I ask, and when is protected teaching time?

journey.label: 8 · Progress sessions
journey.doctorJob: Staged increase only after reliability and cover
journey.question: When can I add sessions without breaking continuity?

journey.label: 9 · Settle / transition
journey.doctorJob: Term end or early-career BAU; optional stay conversation
journey.question: What does success look like at term end / month 3?

trainingSupport.standard: Rostered where term requires; not stolen from lunch by default
Same Day-1 pathways as First 90 Days
Practice shares placement logistics; college remains training authority
Interests inside continuity GP care; credential before promote

supervisionConversations.label: Kick-off
supervisionConversations.focus: Goals, escalation, when to interrupt, documentation expectations

supervisionConversations.label: Scheduled supervision
supervisionConversations.artefact: Log date, duration, themes (no patient identifiers)

supervisionConversations.label: Ad-hoc clinical access
supervisionConversations.artefact: Backup supervisor named when primary away

supervisionConversations.label: Mid-term / Month 1 review
supervisionConversations.focus: Progress, session load, learning needs, wellbeing
supervisionConversations.artefact: Adjust sessions only with capacity rules

supervisionConversations.label: End-term / Month 3 review
supervisionConversations.focus: Continuity habits, observed practice strengths, next stage
supervisionConversations.artefact: College paperwork separate from WMC stay conversation

supervisionConversations.label: Early-career peer conversations
supervisionConversations.focus: Peer discussion rather than formal training supervision
supervisionConversations.artefact: Optional — not a shadow registrar program

sessionProgression.footprint: Agreed minimum reliable footprint (often fewer sessions)

sessionProgression.gate: No unilateral add; reliability at practice threshold

sessionProgression.footprint: Month 2: unmet demand or training need noted
Month 3 or new term: staged add (e.g. +1 half-day)
sessionProgression.gate: Supervisor/buddy available; nursing cover; continuity preserved
Honest reset preferred to burnout or unsafe lists

readinessSignals.applies: registrar: term & stage · early_career: fellowship status

readinessSignals.tool: Supervisor calendar before term dates offered

practiceRole: Track application status as the doctor reports it
cannotDo: Issue, approve, or guarantee a provider number
Override Services Australia timelines or outcomes
providerNumberGuidance.registrarNote: Training placement does not replace Services Australia requirements. Confirm any training-specific billing rules with official sources.
providerNumberGuidance.earlyCareerNote: A new practice location often needs a location-linked number even if a number already exists elsewhere.
providerNumberGuidance.goLiveConstraint: Billing go-live waits on Services Australia outcome where required; orientation may complete earlier.

website.title: Registrar and early-career pathways | Woolloongabba Medical Centre
website.h1: Registrar and early-career pathways at Woolloongabba Medical Centre
website.lede: If you are training in general practice or recently finding your consulting feet, this page explains how support, supervision conversations, sessions and provider-number preparation work here — so you can decide if a conversation with the practice makes sense.

blocks.heading: Training support
blocks.job: What support looks like day to day

blocks.heading: Readiness
blocks.job: CTA to Doctor Readiness — not an offer

blocks.heading: Questions doctors ask
blocks.job: Visible FAQ synced to FAQPage schema

trackCards.registrar: Expressions of interest from GP registrars are welcome. Placements depend on supervisor capacity, rooms, nursing cover and timing — considered against current practice need, not as an always-open intake.
trackCards.earlyCareer: Early-career GPs who value continuity can discuss staged sessions, nursing partnership and peer access. Formal college supervision is not assumed; reliable consulting support is.

website.providerLine: Medicare provider numbers are issued by Services Australia. Woolloongabba Medical Centre does not issue, approve or guarantee provider numbers. We can share accurate practice location details to support your application.

operationalWorkflow.label: Enquiry intake
actions: Capture training stage / fellowship / preferred term or sessions

operationalWorkflow.label: Capacity screen
actions: Registrar: check supervisor FTE and leave for term window
Both: rooms and nursing for proposed sessions

operationalWorkflow.label: Human gate
actions: Practice manager + (registrar) supervisor decide progress / waitlist / decline politely

operationalWorkflow.label: Readiness pack
actions: Doctor completes Readiness and PN checklist
Practice sends location pack and support matrix

operationalWorkflow.label: Credentials and PN track
actions: Run onboarding credential and PN stages
Keep external waits visible on dashboard

operationalWorkflow.label: Session agreement
actions: Written starting footprint; registrar term dates
HotDoc visibility equals agreed sessions only

operationalWorkflow.label: Supervision setup
actions: Book kick-off conversation; name backup supervisor
Early-career: name buddy; optional fortnightly slot

operationalWorkflow.label: Go-live to First 90 / term
actions: Progression reviews at Week 1, Month 1, Month 2, Month 3 / mid-term

operationalWorkflow.label: Close / transition
actions: Stay / finish / staged growth — college outcomes remain separate

raci.duty: Teaching, case review, safety escalation, term feedback
Capacity, credentials sighting, PN location pack, roster
Treatment-room integration, procedural support within scope
Booking rules, continuity offers, interrupt protocol
Peer access and local systems tips — not college supervisor
Documents, SA application, supervision attendance, honest load feedback
